items.heading: Line Up Every Placed Student
items.text: Line up every placed student from the lowest salary to the highest. The student standing in the exact middle has the median CTC. LPA means lakh per annum, and one lakh is 1,00,000 rupees.

items.heading: These Three Numbers Can Come
items.text: These three numbers can come from the same batch and tell three different stories. Each one answers a different question.

items.heading: Iit Bombay's 2024
items.text: IIT Bombay's 2024-25 placement season shows the gap between average and median in a real batch. The Free Press Journal reported that 2,469 students registered, 2,040 took part in recruitment and 1,422 students were placed.

items.heading: A Company Offers a Job
items.text: A company offers a job through the college. The company visits the campus or runs an online drive for the college. A student who clears the tests and interviews gets an offer.

items.heading: The College Counts That Student
items.text: The college counts that student as placed. The usual test is an accepted offer. Some colleges also count internships or stipend-only roles, so ask what counts.

items.heading: The Placement Percentage Divides Placed
items.text: The placement percentage divides placed students by a group. The group can be the whole batch, the students eligible for placements, or only the students who registered. The bigger the group, the lower the percentage.
